label: Philadelphia

county_election_office.name: Philadelphia County Board of Elections (the City Commissioners), City Hall, Room 142, 1400 John F. Kennedy Blvd., Philadelphia, PA 19107

zip_caveats: A ZIP code won't tell you your races inside Philadelphia. Every Philadelphia ballot has the governor's race and both charter-change questions, but your U.S. House, state Senate and state House races depend on your address, and the city prints 48 ballot styles. Several state House districts are split between congressional districts (175, 181, 182, 195 and 198 between Districts 2 and 3; 184, 185, 186 and 191 between Districts 3 and 5), and 30 of the 48 styles have no state Senate race at all, because only Senate districts 2, 4 and 8 are on the ballot this year. Each style has a code like 3-8-188: U.S. House District 3, state Senate District 8, state House District 188, with 'xx' meaning no state Senate race (checked against all 48 official sample ballots). To see your exact ballot, find your districts (the app's address lookup can match them), then open the matching style under 'Sample Ballots by Split' at vote.phila.gov/voting/candidates-for-office. The city's Find my Polling Place tool is atlas.phila.gov/voting. ZIPs that cross the county line (Census 2020 ZIP-area data): 19118 (Chestnut Hill) and 19128 (Roxborough and Manayunk) dip slightly into Montgomery County, and about 29 percent of 19153's land is in Delaware County.
notes: Philadelphia has 48 ballot styles. Everyone votes for governor and on two city charter-change questions; your U.S. House, state Senate (if you have one this year) and state House races depend on your address. On the mail ballot the two questions are on the back, so vote both sides. No judicial races are on Philadelphia's ballot this year. For mail ballot services, City Hall Room 140 and the 10 district satellite offices list weekday hours of 9 AM to 5 PM and weekend hours of 10 AM to 4 PM in the 2026 post updated October 17. Apply by 5 PM on October 27. Check for hour changes before leaving. The city map marks the Vogt Recreation Center drop box out of order due to construction; use another listed location.
